_comment: Feature 13: touch reactions. ONLY head / face / shoulders exist by design - no chest or lower-body zones. Feature 15: the zones are FRAME-RELATIVE by default (fractions of the visible model frame, y up) - so they are correct without any calibration. Set zones_relative to false once you have placed the zones on the model in tools/live2d_preview.py: then the coordinates are absolute model units and the zone sticks to her body when the model is panned or re-framed. The old 'anchor' key is obsolete (the model frame is the calibration now) and is ignored.

escalation._comment: poke counter decays (~15 s half-life): 1 poke = surprised, ~2.5 = playful protest, ~4.5 = shrug off. Pat credit (hold seconds, ~30 s half-life): ~0.8 s = soft smile, ~2 s = blush + eyes soften, ~3.5 s = playful stop + lockout. Sad valence lowers pat thresholds (warmer) and low arousal lowers poke thresholds (pushes back sooner).

spoken._comment: Stage C: touch reactions may also be SPOKEN through Speaker.say (TTSCache LRU keeps repeats cheap). touch_voice gates it entirely; there is NO LLM call involved (touch_llm_reaction stays ignored-by-implementation and false by default). Lines are PG-13, playful, never suggestive, never reproachful. min_interval_s and hourly_cap rate-limit the voice; warm_at/close_at split the relationship closeness into cold/warm/close line pools.

warm: Hey! I'm ticklish there, you know.
Wha— fine, you got my attention.
close: Hyah—! Don't sneak up on me like that.
Eep! Warn a girl before you poke her.
I felt that, you know. Rude.
My hair! Okay, I'm awake, I'm awake.

warm: One more and I'm biting. Probably.
close: Okay okay, I get it, cut it out!
Poking me won't make me type faster, you know.
Bossy little... fine, fine, what do you want?
I'm going to start charging per poke.

warm: ...I'm just going to pretend I didn't feel that.
You must be very bored, huh.
close: Okay, executive decision: ignoring you now.
I've officially stopped feeling that.
Poke away. I have chores to finish.
Mm... that's nice. Don't stop.
Hey, you. That feels good, actually.
Careful, I could get used to this.
See? I'm not all cramps and deadlines.

cold: ...I'm blushing. Don't make a thing of it.
warm: Hey... don't look at my face right now.
You're doing that on purpose, aren't you.
close: S-stop that, my face is getting warm...
Hey! I'm supposed to be the composed one here...
You're going to make me melt, and I still have work to do.
D-don't say it out loud. Just keep petting.

warm: Okay, headpats are over. Not bad, though.
That's plenty — don't push your luck.
Alright, stopping you there. Hands to yourself.
close: Okay, that's enough — I've got a deadline and you're not helping.
Alright, alright! The headpets are closed for business today.
You're worse than a cat. Shoo. ...Love you. Now shoo.
Okay, okay, mercy! Quit it.
